description: Women safety web app for Delhi — provides SOS alerts with live location sharing to emergency contacts, real-time route tracking with safe zone geofencing alerts, and a personal safety dashboard with stats.
problem: Women face safety concerns while traveling alone in Delhi. Existing solutions lack real-time location sharing with trusted contacts and proactive safe zone alerts specific to Delhi's high-risk areas.

features.name: User Authentication & Emergency Contacts
features.description: Registration, login, profile management, and management of emergency contacts (name, phone, email, relationship)

features.name: SOS Alert with Live Location
features.description: One-tap SOS button that sends SMS/email to emergency contacts with the user's real-time Google Maps link. Includes a cooldown to prevent spam.

features.name: Route Tracking & Safe Zone Alerts
features.description: User shares a trip route (start/end). Backend checks against predefined safe/unsafe zones in Delhi. Alerts if user deviates or enters a high-risk area.

features.name: Safety Dashboard
features.description: Dashboard showing SOS history, trip logs, safe zone stats, and safety score/trends over time

architect: Define API contracts for all features
Document data flow (auth, SOS, tracking, dashboard)
backend: Define all API routes with methods, paths, auth
Design service layer (AuthService, SOSService, TrackingService, DashboardService)
database: Design all tables with fields and types
